info.name: Livestock ERP — API Changes — 2026-10-16
info.description: Collection for the API changes delivered on 2026-10-16. Includes supplier creation without minimum_order_amount or opening_balance_type inputs, and the customer receivables ledger read endpoint. Examples were captured from the authenticated dev API at http://localhost:8089/api/v1. Positive supplier opening balances default to AP credit. The supplier example creates a record; change supplierTag before running it again. Customer 2 and supplier 5 are dev test records.
